column3: Kuroneko Route · The Frying Pan and the Fish
I bought the souvenir you requested from Kyoto.
I see. But I don't need it anymore.
Huh? What's with that, what do you mean?
I changed my mind and there isn't any other reason.
W-W-Wait... Did something happen while I was at Kyoto?
Not really.
Something DID happen.
...Anyway, let's go home together.
Together... with you...?
We can't?
...Hmph, is it necessary to do such a thing?
There isn't any reason for me to go home together with you.
We can't go home together without a reason?
...Yes, that's right. Any action must have an accompanying valid aim.
Aimless actions, are as pointless as dead leaves floating in water.
Huh...
But still... Isn't she being unnaturally peculiar? This girl...
...Huh?
W-What is she saying? This girl...
Did you not hear me?
Then I shall re-iterate, there isn't any reason for me to go home with you.
Y-You don't have to say it so bluntly...?
Hmm... I simply wish that you would understand it...
I cannot be in your presence.
What's going on? Doesn't Kuroneko seem strange?
Then, what should I do...?
Sorry, but I don't have the time to play around right now.
Goodbye then, senpai.
Kuroneko, can I ask you something?
What would that be?
Uh, it's just a theory...
...What?
C-Could it be that you have someone you're interested in?
W-Why would that be the case?!
I-I see... I can finally relax a little...
W-Why did you say such a confusing thing all of a sudden...
That sounded really cold... I'll get lonely...
Isn't that your problem? I have my own matters to attend to.
Eh, what kind of matter?
...I need not tell you.
Furthermore, being lonely is a lie, am I right? Senpai already has Belphegor... no, Tamura-senpai.
Why did you mention Manami here? She doesn't have anything to do with this.
Besides, it's true that I'll get lonely if you're not around.
...Senpai, I'll take the chance to make it clear to you.
Oh, what is it?
...Don't get involved with me any further.
What's that, trying out a new joke?
If that's what you think, you're really a happy-go-lucky person.
That's because I wanted it to be a joke! Because...
Because... of what?
Won't I feel lonely if that's not the case?
...Even if you give me that look, that won't change my mind.
What's that supposed to mean? I don't get it.
It doesn't matter if you don't get it, I just wanted to tell you that.
You have to give me a reason, you know.
I don't need to give one, it is useless even if I do.
Why is it useless? How would you know if you don't say it out?
The outcome will be better for both of us that way...
I-Isn't there things you ought to do?
T-Things I ought to do...?
Good grief... Isn't senpai preparing for his exams?
Do you understand now? We both have things we need to do. So it is for our mutual sake to do so.
Do you think I'll just accept that? Explain yourself properly!
Don't presume that you can get people to tell you everything you want.
There are many things that people can't say to others.
Even so...
I don't get it at all...
Yes, that's perfectly fine. I also thought you wouldn't understand.
What's with that...
Useless means useless.
Right now, your will is nothing but an hindrance for my soul. That is why I have to distance myself from you.
What's that about...
It is as I said.
This marks the end of our conversation.
H-Hey? What's gotten into you?
I have no need nor obligation to answer you.
Do you really have to say it like that? Even though I'm worried about you...
Can you not be so depressed? It's unsightly.
...Hold it.
There is nothing more I have to say.
You said "don't get involved with me any further" earlier on... Are you serious about that?
...Yes, I am.
...Don't get involved with me anymore.
What's... with that...
I'm somehow feeling quite depressed.
I'm even shocked at myself, why... do I... feel so sad?
